name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Monticello Composite Squadron
org: Civil Air Patrol, Monticello Composite Squadron (Virginia Wing)
what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
who_can_apply: Cadets ages 12 to 18. The Virginia Wing site lists Become a Cadet as ages 12 to 18. The national Civil Air Patrol page says cadets can join at ages 12 through 18.
pay_detail: Civil Air Patrol says annual dues are $25 to $50 depending on location, and a fully active cadet may spend $300 to $600 in the first year (minus financial help). The squadron page does not state its own dues.
duration: The squadron meets each Tuesday from 7 to 9 p.m. at Lakeside Middle School.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron any time.
how_to_apply: Send the squadron a message on Facebook or email 091.pa@vawg.cap.gov and they will be in touch. The Virginia Wing headquarters number on the page is 804-454-7356.
notes: Confirm first: the squadron page gives no street address, so ask for the exact meeting location before you go. The dues range and first-year cost come from the national Civil Air Patrol cadet page.
